items.title: Holy Mass with the Music of St. Hildegard von Bingen
items.location: The Church of St. Rocco, 18 Third St., Glen Cove, NY, 7:00 pm
items.body: Music led by Dr. Christa Dalmazio and Mrs. Theresa Volpe. Following Mass, all are invited to light refreshments and a lecture on St. Hildegard by Dr. Dalmazio.

items.title: Featured by The Good Newsroom
items.body: The Archdiocese of New York's Good Newsroom visited Holy Innocents Parish to talk with Christa about living out her faith through sacred music.

items.title: Glorious Mystery now streaming
items.body: Six Marian chants recorded live at Holy Cross Church in Rumson, New Jersey, with Christa on harp, alongside soprano Dr. Carly York. Available on all major platforms.

items.title: An Advent Concert Experience with Higher Word
items.location: St. Joseph's Church in Greenwich Village, 371 Sixth Avenue, New York, NY, 7:15 PM
items.body: An intimate, chamber-sized concert of familiar and lesser-known music for Advent, from Higher Word, where Christa is music director. Tickets will be available soon.

items.title: Heavenly Host: A Concert for the Feast of the Guardian Angels
items.location: St. Jean Baptiste Church, 184 East 76th Street, New York, NY, 7:15 PM
items.body: Higher Word's season-opening orchestra concert, with music recalling the words of the angels in Scripture, from Biebl's Ave Maria to the Gloria of Bach's Mass in B Minor.

items.title: All Hallows
items.location: Church of St. Anthony of Padua, 154 Sullivan Street, New York, NY
items.body: Christa and Jacob Beranek conducted more than forty musicians of the Higher Word Orchestra in music by Mozart, Beethoven, and other composers, a meditation on everlasting life for All Saints and All Souls.
